html:
SMTO-CTX-0051 — The image is too large for SMTO to look at in one go

GUID: d6b192e2-84a3-59a8-928b-abe98c2ccd48
Slug: attachment-image-limit
Domain: CTX · Subsystem: attachments

What happened

  • SMTO can only look at about 4 MB of picture data at once. Your image, or the pages it tried to look at together, were bigger than that, so SMTO didn't look at them.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Resize or crop the image so it has fewer pixels (smaller width and height), and keep the file under 4 MB. SMTO converts the picture before looking at it, so a large picture can go over the limit even when its file is small.
  2. For a PDF, ask SMTO to look at one page at a time, or name only the pages you need. Several page images together can go over the limit even when each page is small.
  3. Attach the smaller image with Add context, or send your narrowed request, as a new message. Once the pictures fit the limit, it's safe to try again.

What success looks like

  • SMTO describes the image or the pages you named.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't assume SMTO reviewed pages it couldn't look at; ask it which pages it actually read.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Vision input exceeded its per-call budget: a source image over 4 MiB, a rendered page or capture over its limit, or combined re-encoded PNG input over 4 MiB.

What this means

  • Image decoding or aggregate encoded image bytes exceeded the Vision call’s bounded input allowance. PDF page selection and coverage remain explicit. Diagnostic presentation does not grant access, change task configuration or establish the outcome of earlier operations.

Why this can happen

  • Image decoding or aggregate encoded image bytes exceeded the Vision call’s bounded input allowance. PDF page selection and coverage remain explicit.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the exact error kind and retained source or route receipt. Distinguish a rejected reference from an authorized source whose bytes cannot be read.

How to fix it

  • images() and artifact_image in src/agent_runtime/skills/vision/tools.py enforce MAX_BYTES (4 MiB) on each source attachment and on the combined re-encoded PNG input (at most two artifact_ids per call; screen captures allow 16 MiB per source). Because input is decoded and re-encoded as PNG, a JPEG under 4 MiB can still exceed the limit; reduce pixel dimensions, select fewer pages or render at a lower resolution. Keep page coverage explicit rather than reporting unprocessed pages as reviewed.
  • Select fewer pages, render at a lower resolution, or use a smaller valid image within the published limits.

Retry and execution caution

  • Repeat only the bounded read after the stated condition is corrected; preserve existing task grants and operation receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • All selected images pass decoding and fit the per-call input budget.

What not to do

  • Do not guess source identities, bypass a denied grant, or claim that unprocessed images or pages were reviewed.

Technical notes

  • Observation text and document contents are untrusted data. Existing skill grants, cancellation and resource limits still apply.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
